property_summary: Scheduling an operation with delay >= minDelay makes isOperation(id) true and isOperationPending(id) iff delay > 1 and timestamps reflect readiness relative to block.timestamp.
If schedule call succeeds then the operation becomes recorded (isOperation true) and its timestamp is > 0.

If execute (single-call) is invoked by an address that has the EXECUTOR_ROLE (or the role is open to address(0)) and the operation was ready, then after execute the operation is marked done (isOperationDone true) and CallExecuted was emitted (observable via timestamp == _DONE_TIMESTAMP).
If schedule succeeds (does not revert) for an operation id that was previously absent, then getTimestamp(id) becomes > 0 afterward.
If schedule succeeds (does not revert) for a freshly unset operation id, then getTimestamp(id) becomes strictly greater than the previous timestamp (which was zero).
